title: paragynoxys angosturae
intro: Paragynoxys angosturae, commonly known as Angostura or Angostura tree, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Paragynoxys angosturae are attributed to its ability to relax smooth muscles, reduce anxiety, and lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include xanthonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
